comparison.objective: Tune and lock a damper vs index and seat a servo horn on a splined shaft at zero.
comparison.physical_skill: Recessed key insertion, fine collar rotation and torque control vs submillimetric coaxial alignment, tooth-phase selection and press seating.
comparison.success_condition: Two dynamically acceptable stops with no drift vs horn flush on spline index zero within 2 degrees, still and released.
comparison.reason: Fine angular alignment is shared, but spline-phase insertion is a different tested ability from iterative damping adjustment and locking.
